ConnectionStrings.//: No value here on purpose. Supply it per environment via appsettings.Development.json (untracked), user-secrets, or the ConnectionStrings__HrPortal environment variable. A committed default would point some deployment at the wrong database.

Jwt.//Secret: MUST come from App__Jwt__Secret. No default: the app fails to start rather than signing with a publicly-known key. Must match the Spring backend's APP_JWT_SECRET while both run side by side, or tokens issued by one are rejected by the other.
